WITH e AS (SELECT timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00' t),
fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.market_ticker FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t),
snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC)
SELECT lpad(to_char(realized_pnl,'FM990.00'),7) k, market_ticker v FROM snap WHERE qty=0 AND realized_pnl<0 ORDER BY realized_pnl
